target.title: fix(ui): mobile-optimize gateway dashboard login gate
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Gateway Dashboard login gate (Control UI) is not mobile-optimized and is visually noisy. On phones:

- Page (24px) + card (32px) padding eats ~112px of a 375px viewport, squeezing the form.
- The gate renders outside the app shell, so it gets no safe-area padding; with `viewport-fit=cover` the error card/help text runs into the iPhone home-bar area.
- Touch targets are below the 44px platform guideline: inputs ~35px, eye-toggle buttons 40px.
- The WebSocket URL field uses a default text keyboard with autocapitalize/autocorrect, which mangles `ws://` URLs, and it is the only field without Enter-to-connect.
- The always-expanded "How to connect" help block and the fully expanded connection-error callout push the form off-screen on phones; the error steps alone fill more than a viewport.

## Why This Change Was Made

Users connect to the dashboard from phones (`openclaw dashboard` link/QR flow). The login gate is the first surface they hit and should follow the mobile conventions the rest of the Control UI already uses (`layout.mobile.css` breakpoint, `--safe-area-*` vars, 44px targets), and stay compact enough to fit one screen.

## User Impact

- Simpler login screen on all form factors: the "How to connect" help and the connection-error callout are now native `<details>` disclosures, collapsed by default (title always visible, one tap/click to expand). The whole gate fits a single phone screen.
- On phones (≤768px, plus small-landscape): tighter page/card padding with safe-area-aware insets, and 44px minimum touch targets for inputs, the token/password visibility toggles, and Connect.
- URL field: URL keyboard (`inputmode="url"`), no autocapitalize/autocorrect, "go" enter key, and Enter now connects (parity with token/password fields).
- Desktop layout metrics unchanged apart from the collapsed-by-default sections.

## Evidence

- Verified via Vite dev server with device emulation at 375×812 (portrait), 844×390 (landscape), and desktop width:
  - mobile: `.login-gate` padding `16px 12px` (safe-area `max()`), card `24px 20px`, computed `min-height: 44px` on inputs/Connect, 44×44 eye toggles; full card (form + both collapsed disclosures) fits the 812px viewport.
  - both disclosures expand correctly with all prior content intact (failure summary, numbered steps, raw-error sub-details, docs links; help steps with copyable commands).
  - desktop (>768px): unchanged `24px`/`32px` padding, no min-height overrides.
- Input font-size on real touch devices stays 16px (existing `(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)` rule in `components.css`, which cascades after `layout.mobile.css`) — no iOS zoom-on-focus.
- `oxfmt --check` and `scripts/run-oxlint.mjs` clean on changed files; Codex autoreview run on both commits.
- Collapsed-by-default connection error is an intentional product decision (maintainer request) — the title row stays visible as the failure signal; recovery steps are one tap away (noted inline in `login-gate.ts`).
